CustomField.label: Offer status
CustomField.description: SCRUM-467: expiry state at a glance - "offer expired", "offer valid today", "offer valid for N more days". No offer recorded = blank. System-computed formula field, read-only; no length element on Text formula fields.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Offer_Expires_On__c), null, IF(Offer_Expires_On__c < TODAY(), "offer expired", IF(Offer_Expires_On__c = TODAY(), "offer valid today", "offer valid for " & TEXT(Offer_Expires_On__c - TODAY()) & " more days")))
